annotation.title_clean: AI セーフティに関する評価観点ガイド（第1.01版）
annotation.title_en: Guide to Evaluation Perspectives on AI Safety (Version 1.01)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: AI セーフティ・インスティテュート (Japan AI Safety Institute)
annotation.summary_en: Guide by Japan's AI Safety Institute setting out evaluation perspectives for AI safety, aimed at AI developers and providers. It defines key elements (human-centricity, safety, fairness, privacy, security, transparency) and ten evaluation perspectives for LLM systems, plus evaluators, timing, and methods such as red teaming. Voluntary and LLM-focused.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines AI safety around human-centricity, safety, fairness, privacy, security and transparency, based on Japan's AI Guidelines for Business.
Sets ten evaluation perspectives, including harmful output control, misinformation, fairness, high-risk use, privacy, security, explainability, robustness, data quality and verifiability.
Targets developers and providers, with development/provision managers as main evaluators and executives as accountable.
Describes technical evaluation (tools, red teaming) and management-based evaluation across the lifecycle.
Voluntary, living document; not intended to restrict AI innovation.
